info.name: Student CV CRUD REST API with Individual Login
info.description: Postman Collection for testing Multi-Student CV CRUD Operations with Central Shared Database, Individual Student Login, and Owner Authorization.

item.name: Auth - 1. Student Login (Sign In with Password)

request.description: Individual student login with Student ID and Password. Automatically saves Bearer token for subsequent requests.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Sakib Al Hasan",
  "student_id": "2239999",
  "email": "sakib@iub.edu.bd",
  "password": "pass1234",
  "education": "BSc in Computer Science & Engineering",
  "skills": ["Python", "Django", "PostgreSQL"],
  "experience": "Junior Software Engineer",
  "bio": "Passionate about full-stack web engineering."
}

request.description: Register a new student with password and automatically save their CV to the database.

item.name: Auth - 3. Get Currently Logged In Profile (Me)

request.description: Retrieve the profile of the currently logged-in student using Bearer token.
View all students' CV records from the shared database.

item.name: CRUD - 5. GET Single Student CV (Read Student A)

request.description: Retrieve full profile information for a specific student by ID.

item.name: CRUD - 7. PUT Update CV (Unauthorized - Test 403 Forbidden)

request.description: Logged in as Student B (ID: 2230907), trying to edit Student A's CV (#101). Expected: 403 Forbidden.
Owner deletes their CV from the database.
